title.zh: 全量词库学习者优先质量复审

purpose.en: Repair vocabulary defects discovered by a real learner walkthrough and prevent later catalog migrations from restoring unsuitable definitions.
purpose.zh: 修复真实学习者测试发现的词义问题，并防止后续词库迁移重新覆盖为不适合学习者的释义。

en: Replay and audit all 48,000 published vocabulary rows across twelve languages and three course levels.
Apply 112 forward-only learner-first corrections while preserving stable IDs, pronunciation data, and learner progress.
Replace obsolete, derogatory, overly technical, repeated, malformed, and mistranslated meanings with concise course-ready glosses.
Strengthen release gates for migration ordering, multilingual gold meanings, and unbounded obsolete or derogatory labels.
zh: 重放并审计十二种语言、三级课程的全部 48,000 个已发布词条。
以前向迁移修正 112 个词条，同时保留稳定 ID、发音数据和学习进度。
将过时、歧视性、过度技术化、重复、残缺或误译释义替换为简洁可学的释义。
强化迁移顺序、多语言标准词义以及过时或歧视性标签的发布门禁。

en: Add forward migrations 0153 and 0154 for the verified corrections.
Make the quality audit replay semantic corrections after bulk catalog repairs, matching production order.
Extend the reviewed multilingual meaning set and regression assertions.
zh: 增加前向迁移 0153 与 0154，部署已复核的修正。
让质量审计按生产顺序在批量修复后重放语义修正。
扩充人工复核的多语言标准词义及回归断言。

en: The deterministic replay contains exactly 48,000 published rows and reports zero quality findings.
Vocabulary catalog and quality regression tests pass before the full repository gate.
Production will be rechecked with the same real test learner after deployment.
zh: 确定性重放包含恰好 48,000 个已发布词条，质量问题为零。
词库目录与质量回归测试已通过，随后执行全仓发布门禁。
部署后使用同一真实测试学习账号复测生产环境。

en: Browser automation cannot provide a genuine learner voice, so pronunciation scores are never fabricated.
zh: 浏览器自动化不能提供真人语音，因此不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This is a SmartLingo learning-data release and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 学习数据发布，不改变其他站点。
